top_signals.title: China Warns Broad EU Tariffs Could Disrupt Trade Negotiations
top_signals.summary: China vowed to retaliate if the European Union adopts broad tariffs on Chinese goods modeled on previous US measures, warning that such action could undermine trade negotiations with the bloc.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Igarashi and Ikeda clinch surfing gold at Asian Games
top_signals.summary: Japan also secured another medal in surfing, with Minami Nonaka securing bronze in the women's shortboard event.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: IPO postponements are accelerating in third quarter, even beyond Oura
top_signals.summary: It's been a strong year for IPOs. But now, more companies are deciding to stay on the sidelines.
